fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Entry to Bangladesh requires a passport with at least 2 blank pages and no damage.
entry.es: Para entrar en Bangladés, el pasaporte debe tener al menos 2 páginas en blanco y no estar dañado.
entry.quote: To enter Bangladesh, your passport must have at least 2 blank pages and no damage.

entry.en: Bangladesh has online arrival and departure registration for foreign nationals, and an electronic arrival card may be required before entering.
entry.es: Bangladés tiene registro electrónico de llegada y salida para extranjeros, y puede exigirse una tarjeta electrónica de llegada antes de entrar.
entry.quote: Bangladesh has introduced online arrival and departure registration for foreign nationals. Travellers may be required to complete an electronic arrival card before entering Bangladesh

entry.en: You may need to show a return or onward ticket at Bangladeshi border control.
entry.es: Es posible que debas mostrar un billete de vuelta o de continuación en el control fronterizo de Bangladés.
entry.quote: At Bangladeshi border control, you may also need to show a return or onward ticket.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you come from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si vienes de un país catalogado como de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk

entry.en: You may need to declare foreign currency or Bangladeshi taka, depending on the amount you carry.
entry.es: Puede que debas declarar divisas extranjeras o taka bangladesí, según la cantidad que lleves.
entry.quote: You may need to declare foreign currency or Bangladeshi taka, depending on the amount you are travelling with.

entry.en: A return ticket and proof of funds are needed to apply for a visa on arrival at Dhaka airport.
entry.es: Se necesitan billete de vuelta y prueba de fondos para solicitar el visado a la llegada en el aeropuerto de Daca.
entry.quote: You must have a return ticket and proof of funds to apply for a visa on arrival.

safety.en: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Bangladesh.
safety.es: Es muy probable que terroristas intenten cometer atentados en Bangladés.
safety.quote: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Bangladesh.

safety.en: Political rallies and demonstrations can quickly turn violent and lead to clashes.
safety.es: Los mítines y manifestaciones políticas pueden volverse violentos rápidamente y provocar enfrentamientos.
safety.quote: Political rallies and demonstrations can quickly turn violent leading to clashes.

safety.en: Passengers on rickshaws, taxis, buses or trains are vulnerable to violent crime, particularly at night.
safety.es: Los pasajeros de rickshaws, taxis, autobuses o trenes son vulnerables a delitos violentos, sobre todo de noche.
safety.quote: Passengers using rickshaws, taxis, buses or trains are vulnerable to violent crime, particularly at night.

safety.en: Female travellers often experience verbal and physical harassment by individuals or groups of men.
safety.es: Las viajeras suelen sufrir acoso verbal y físico por parte de hombres, solos o en grupo.
safety.quote: Female travellers often experience verbal and physical harassment by individuals or groups of men.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all but essential travel to the Chittagong Hill Tracts.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje salvo el esencial a los Distritos de las Colinas de Chittagong.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all but essential travel to the Chittagong Hill Tracts, an area made up of the districts of:

safety.en: Alcoholic drinks containing methanol have caused deaths and serious illness in Bangladesh.
safety.es: Las bebidas alcohólicas con metanol han causado muertes y enfermedades graves en Bangladés.
safety.quote: There have been deaths and cases of serious illness caused by alcoholic drinks containing methanol in Bangladesh.

health.en: Medical facilities in Bangladesh are poor and routine tests and X-rays are unreliable.
health.es: Las instalaciones médicas en Bangladés son deficientes y las pruebas rutinarias y radiografías no son fiables.
health.quote: Medical facilities in Bangladesh are poor. Routine tests and X-rays are unreliable.

health.en: Dengue fever can occur year-round but is more widespread in the rainy season, May to September.
health.es: El dengue puede darse todo el año pero es más frecuente en la temporada de lluvias, de mayo a septiembre.
health.quote: dengue fever, a mosquito-borne disease that can occur year-round but is more widespread during the rainy season, May to September

health.en: Severe air pollution is a health risk, especially from November to March.
health.es: La contaminación del aire grave es un riesgo para la salud, sobre todo de noviembre a marzo.
health.quote: severe air pollution, especially from November to March

health.en: Travel insurance and access to money for local treatment or medical evacuation are advised.
health.es: Se aconseja tener seguro de viaje y acceso a dinero para tratamiento local o evacuación médica.
health.quote: you have appropriate travel insurance and access to money for local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation

health.en: Bottled water is recommended because the tap water is not certified as potable.
health.es: Se recomienda agua embotellada porque el agua del grifo no está certificada como potable.
health.quote: Bottled water is recommended since BSTI has not certified the tap water as potable.

health.en: Some hand-drawn tube wells are contaminated with naturally occurring arsenic.
health.es: Algunos pozos tubulares manuales están contaminados con arsénico natural.
health.quote: Some hand-drawn tube wells are contaminated with naturally occurring arsenic.

help.en: The emergency number in Bangladesh for ambulance, fire and police is 999.
help.es: El número de emergencias en Bangladés para ambulancia, bomberos y policía es el 999.

help.en: The Bangladesh Police Expatriate Help Cell offers services to expatriates, including dual nationals.
help.es: La Célula de Ayuda a Expatriados de la Policía de Bangladés ofrece servicios a expatriados, incluidos los de doble nacionalidad.
help.quote: The Bangladesh Police Expatriate Help Cell offers services to expatriates, including dual nationals.

getting_in.en: Bangladesh has three international airports: Dhaka (DAC), Chittagong (CGP) and Sylhet (ZYL).
getting_in.es: Bangladés tiene tres aeropuertos internacionales: Daca (DAC), Chittagong (CGP) y Sylhet (ZYL).
getting_in.quote: there are three international airports in Bangladesh which connect it to the rest of the world. These are Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport (DAC IATA) in Dhaka, Shah Amanat International Airport (CGP IATA) in Chittagong and Osmani International Airport (ZYL IATA) in Sylhet.

getting_in.en: The main gateway to the country is Dhaka's Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport.
getting_in.es: La principal puerta de entrada al país es el aeropuerto internacional Hazrat Shahjalal de Daca.
getting_in.quote: The main gateway to the country is Dhaka's Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport

getting_in.en: The only open land borders are with India, and no land crossing to Myanmar is possible.
getting_in.es: Las únicas fronteras terrestres abiertas son con la India, y no es posible cruzar por tierra a Myanmar.
getting_in.quote: The only open land borders are those with India. No land crossing is possible to Myanmar.

getting_around.en: Rickshaw fares should be agreed before riding, as most pullers do not speak English.
getting_around.es: Conviene acordar la tarifa del rickshaw antes de subir, ya que la mayoría de los conductores no habla inglés.
getting_around.quote: Agree on the fare before you ride and make sure they understand where you want to go because most rickshaw pullers do not speak English.

getting_around.en: Ride-hailing services in cities include Obhai, Pathao, Shohoz and Uber.
getting_around.es: Los servicios de transporte por aplicación en las ciudades incluyen Obhai, Pathao, Shohoz y Uber.
getting_around.quote: Many ride sharing or ride hailing companies provide easy and affordable travel options in cities. These include Obhai, Pathao, Shohoz and Uber.

getting_around.en: Bangladesh Railways is the state and only train operator, and buying tickets at least ten days in advance is recommended.
getting_around.es: Bangladesh Railways es el único operador ferroviario, estatal, y se recomienda comprar los billetes con al menos diez días de antelación.
getting_around.quote: Bangladesh Railways is the state and only train operator.

getting_around.en: Driving yourself in Dhaka is definitely not advised because of the extreme traffic.
getting_around.es: No se aconseja conducir uno mismo en Daca por el tráfico extremo.
getting_around.quote: Traffic in Dhaka has reached unimaginable proportions and driving yourself is definitely not advised.

getting_around.en: Cars officially drive on the left side of the road.
getting_around.es: Oficialmente se conduce por el lado izquierdo de la carretera.
getting_around.quote: Officially cars drive on the left side of the road.

getting_around.en: A Rocket Steamer service connects Dhaka with Morrelganj or Khulna via Barisal.
getting_around.es: Un servicio de vapor Rocket conecta Daca con Morrelganj o Khulna pasando por Barisal.
getting_around.quote: Rocket Steamer service connects Dhaka and Morrelganj or Khulna via Barisal

money.en: The currency of Bangladesh is the Bangladeshi taka (BDT).
money.es: La moneda de Bangladés es el taka bangladesí (BDT).
money.quote: The currency of Bangladesh is the Bangladeshi taka

money.en: ATMs are widely available in cities and smaller towns, and most accept Visa and MasterCard.
money.es: Los cajeros están ampliamente disponibles en ciudades y pueblos pequeños, y la mayoría acepta Visa y MasterCard.
money.quote: ATMs are widely available in all cities and even in smaller towns. Most accept all MasterCard and Visa credit/debit cards.

money.en: ATM withdrawals with foreign cards typically are charged a fee of Tk500.
money.es: Los retiros en cajeros con tarjetas extranjeras suelen tener una comisión de 500 Tk.
money.quote: ATM withdrawals using foreign cards typically are charged a fee of Tk500.

money.en: Most establishments will not accept foreign currency as payment.
money.es: La mayoría de los establecimientos no acepta divisas extranjeras como pago.
money.quote: Most establishments will not accept foreign currency as payment.

money.en: Around 15% tipping is expected in upscale restaurants, but not usually at informal food joints or street vendors.
money.es: En restaurantes de categoría se espera una propina de alrededor del 15%, pero no suele darse en locales informales ni puestos callejeros.
money.quote: In upscale restaurants around 15% is expected, but outside of these at informal food joints and with street food vendors, it's the exception not the rule.

etiquette.en: Use your right hand for shaking hands and handing things over, as the left hand is considered unclean.
etiquette.es: Usa la mano derecha para saludar y entregar cosas, ya que la izquierda se considera impura.
etiquette.quote: Always use your right hand when shaking hands, bringing something to someone, and so on. The left hand is considered unclean in Bangladesh.

etiquette.en: Do not attempt to shake hands with or touch local women.
etiquette.es: No intentes estrechar la mano ni tocar a las mujeres locales.
etiquette.quote: Don't attempt to shake hands with or touch local women; as this is a predominantly Muslim country, appropriate behaviour is expected from you.

etiquette.en: Both men and women should dress modestly, and women should cover their shoulders and legs in public.
etiquette.es: Hombres y mujeres deben vestir con modestia, y las mujeres deben cubrirse hombros y piernas en público.
etiquette.quote: Both men and women should dress modestly to avoid causing offence. Women should cover their shoulders and legs in public.

etiquette.en: During Ramadan you should refrain from eating, drinking, smoking and chewing in public.
etiquette.es: Durante el Ramadán debes abstenerte de comer, beber, fumar y masticar en público.
etiquette.quote: During Ramadan, you should refrain from eating, drinking, smoking, and chewing in public.

etiquette.en: Avoid criticising or speaking badly about religion.
etiquette.es: Evita criticar o hablar mal de la religión.
etiquette.quote: Avoid criticising or speaking badly about religion.

etiquette.en: Do not give Muslims alcohol or non-halal products as gifts.
etiquette.es: No regales alcohol ni productos no halal a los musulmanes.
etiquette.quote: Do not gift Muslims alcohol and non-halal (pork, ham, etc.) products.

connectivity.en: Banglalink and Grameenphone are the most widely available mobile operators, followed by Robi, Teletalk and Airtel.
connectivity.es: Banglalink y Grameenphone son los operadores móviles más disponibles, seguidos de Robi, Teletalk y Airtel.
connectivity.quote: Banglalink and Grameenphone are the most widely available, followed by Robi, Teletalk and Airtel.

connectivity.en: Mobile data is very cheap, with 1GB available for Tk 50 or less from any mobile network.
connectivity.es: Los datos móviles son muy baratos: 1 GB por 50 Tk o menos en cualquier operador.
connectivity.quote: You can buy 1GB data at Tk 50 or less from any mobile network.

connectivity.en: Free WiFi can be found in some places in the cities.
connectivity.es: Se puede encontrar wifi gratuito en algunos lugares de las ciudades.
connectivity.quote: You can also find free WiFi connectivity in some places in the cities.

connectivity.en: The country code for Bangladesh is 880.
connectivity.es: El prefijo telefónico de Bangladés es 880.
connectivity.quote: The country code for Bangladesh is 880.
